adjusted_prescription: This demonstration effectively shows how to integrate natural language processing with real-time data streaming to make dynamic navigation decisions. It illustrates how the system processes live sensor data and language cues to choose the safest and most efficient corridor, adapting as conditions change. Several successful runs are included where the agent navigates different routes such as the right edge, bottom edge, and mixed central corridors while avoiding hazards like fire. Each example highlights the agent’s ability to respond quickly to updated environmental information and language input, ensuring it reaches its goal safely. Users can follow these demos to build their own pipelines that combine language understanding and sensor feedback for real-time adaptive navigation in complex, changing environments.
